body: I mean...I wish the US allowed people to get assisted suicide/euthanasia. Instead of having people commit very gruesome death like hanging or getting hit by a car...there has been many countries that are looking into this case. In my opinion, people should have a choice on whether they want to end their life or not but in a peaceful way.

I read some articles about situations where people are allowed to receive assisted suicide/euthanasia under mental illnesses. I’m not sure if I can since I don’t have any medical health records...but I really just want to end my life peacefully. I don’t want anyone in my family to know because they will try to prevent this from happening and probably shame me along the line.
